The primary source has abbreviated table labels and conflicting results-methods strain labels for several targets; database rows using conflicting strain labels remain source_conflict.
Exact low-concentration hemolysis percentages and HMEC-1 unit conversion in database rows are preserved as conflicts because local primary text does not support those exact values unambiguously.
The local extracted source text records HMEC-1 IC50 as 0.46 with an ambiguous unit marker while the database row encodes 460 uM; this is not promoted to an exact source-verified toxicity value.
Source Table 2 labels the second Candida value under MIC/MBC, while the linked database row uses MFC; the source table value is retained and the database endpoint label is preserved as conflict.
